Stage 12's `bun nv audit python` check now wants the three lines `tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts`'s `auditPython` prints: the Python twins under `benches/userland/` are a bench workload and stay, the launch shims are deleted, and records are audited as well as documents. `bun nv loop --run --stage 12` is green, and the Stage 12 prose in `docs/agent/goals/tooling-overhaul.md` says the same.

ADR 0221 (`docs/decisions/0221.md`) records the data model, the Bun runtime and the generated-output rule. The goal-end gates are green: `bun nv owners --closes tooling-overhaul` and `bun nv playbook --closes tooling-overhaul` name nothing. A run starts with `bun nv loop`, which switches to the next goal itself when this one is reached.

`bun nv decisions --check` reports 44 records without a plain-language summary, 0221 among them. It is not a gate; `bun nv decisions --gate` passes.
